d:
1993 men tin logon ne milkar envidiya ki shuruaat ki thi. aaj yah duniya ki sabse mulyavan kanpniyon men se ek hai aur global AI indastri ki rirh ban chuki hai. lekin jensan huaang ke istife aur unse jure vivad ne kanpni ke bhavishy par kaee saval khare kar die hain.
Is vidiyo men samjhie envidiya ka itihas, geming chips se AI ki duniya tak uska saphar, jensan huaang ki bhumika aur unke jane ka kanpni par kya asar par sakta hai. sath hi janie ki is pure vivad ke tar amerika-chin ke takniki sangharsh, rashtriy suraksha aur AI ki vaishvik pratispardha se kaise jure hain.
